header.requeue_barrier_reason: PR #908 returned DO-NOT-MERGE; findings absorbed and AC-3 rewritten. TWO BLOCKERS. (1) ea_observation.CREATED_BY and ea_dependency.CREATED_BY are the SAME string, so the retraction loop at ea_dependency.py:528-532 deletes the application->ci edges land_ci_records writes -- proven by execution (deleted link ids = ['link-app-to-ci']), and guaranteed to loop because land_ci_records runs at line 1266 and land_dependency_posture at 1282 inside one observe_ea_model call. Measured blast radius from production: 63 such edges exist, all by factory-dispatcher/ea-observer. Fix: give the dependency writer its OWN created_by AND restrict the retraction loop and final_targets to targets that are arch.application; add a test seeding an app->ci edge under the observer's own identity and asserting it survives. (2) THE OUTER LOOP'S FAULT: AC-3 as re-specified this morning was UNSATISFIABLE -- it forbade the live store, forbade the repo, and named a snapshot carrying posture but not workload identity, while requiring the observer be exercised against the cluster; content.workload.objects is store-resident only. AC-3 IS REWRITTEN: the worker no longer reports after-counts at all and SHALL NOT be penalised for their absence; the outer loop runs the live comparison at the gate. AC-3 also now requires the target-type narrowing to have a PRODUCTION CALLER (finding 3: it had none, living only in an uncommitted script), and corrects its own false claim that zero application->ci edges exist -- there are 63, so the F-E coherence case is common, not narrow. Preserved work KEPT: the gate judged this materially better than #863, with carried findings F1/F1b/F3 genuinely fixed and ratchets fired rather than credited. Build on it. Finding 5 (_owner_by_object duplicating ea_observation._owner_lookup) is STRUCTURAL and must NOT ride this behavioral bead.

streak_through_barrier.rule: trailing_environmental_fault_streak over notes with created_at <= requeue_barrier_note_at

header.note_reduction: Each note is {id, created_at, created_by, content: {kind, body_first_line = dispatch.redact_sensitive_output(body).splitlines()[0][:200], ...kind extras}}. status: + environmental_fault_signature, resets_attempts, preserved_choice, releases_work, expedite, class_of_service, expedite_reason, expedite_until (each only if present on the stored note) and requeue_reason (derived: for a resets_attempts note the text after guards._REQUEUE_REASON_MARKER 'Reason:' with the _REQUEUE_PRESERVED_SUFFIX_MARKER tail stripped, parsed from the FULL redacted body; else null). review: + verdict, url (+ pr_url when the stored note carries one). question: + blocking, answers_ref. answer: + answers_ref (+ releases_work when present -- guards.open_questions reads it on the answer, so it is kept there too). attachment: + url. Dropped: provenance, context, trust_tier, full bodies. To feed a reduced note to a guards/dispatch function that reads content.body, map body_first_line -> body; every prefix those functions test for is on the first line (verified at build: see header.reconstruction_check).
header.redaction: no provenance, no worker/model fields, no full bodies; PR URLs kept
